name: Colour Pool
description: A pool of soft colour: blurred blobs drift on slow loops over a base colour, and one follows the pointer.

props.name: colors
props.description: Blob colours. Four or five blobs are drawn, cycling through these; the pointer blob takes the first.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Add a blob that follows the pointer with a soft lag. It rests in place under reduced motion.

props.name: speed
props.description: Multiplier for the drift speed. At 1 each blob takes 20 to 40 seconds per loop.

props.name: blur
props.description: Blur radius of the blobs, in pixels.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which is relative and clips the blobs. Other div props, including pointer handlers, are passed through.
